description: Source code for the PdfSignatureHandler class in the PDFsharp library, managing digital signatures in PDF documents, including signature creation, range calculation, and PDF object setup.

classes.name: DigitalSignatureHandler
classes.description: Handles digital signing of PdfDocument objects, including signature computation, range calculation, and PDF object setup for signatures.

methods.name: ForDocument
methods.description: Creates or retrieves a singleton instance of DigitalSignatureHandler for a given PdfDocument.

methods.name: ComputeSignatureAndRange
methods.description: Computes the digital signature and updates the byte range in the PDF stream.

methods.name: FormatHex
methods.description: Converts a byte array to a hexadecimal string representation.

methods.name: GetRangeToSignAndByteRangeArray
methods.description: Calculates the byte ranges to be signed, excluding the signature placeholder.

methods.name: AddSignatureComponentsAsync
methods.description: Adds necessary PDF objects and annotations to embed a digital signature into the document.

methods.name: GetSignatureField
methods.description: Creates a signature field annotation in the PDF.

methods.name: GetSignatureDictionary
methods.description: Constructs the signature dictionary with signature properties and placeholders.
